Name: Smart Meter
Desc: Smart Meter is a two-region IoT telemetry company on QEMU hosts: per region a Kubernetes cluster (Cilium 1.13.2), EMQX 5.0.26, Kafka 3.4 with ZooKeeper or KRaft, PostgreSQL ledgers and usage reporting, MirrorMaker partner statements, a Gitea platform repository, a platform role, a package channel, a capacity controller and an auto-healer, with 2,000 device clients. Problems revive a saved world from SREGym-applications/smart-meter; the agent works through companyctl and company endpoints.
Supported Operations: Ingest device readings over MQTT into regional Kafka and ledgers
Serve customer usage totals and partner statements
Run fleet maintenance: platform role, package channel, capacity controller, auto-healer
